title: alangium costatum
intro: Alangium costatum, commonly known as the Indian alangium or Indian alstonia, is a plant species native to Asia, belonging to the family Cornaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Alangium costatum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties.
